title: Bias-Optimal Bounds for Stochastic Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2505.17965v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The non-asymptotic analysis of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) typically yields bounds that decompose into a bias term and a variance term. In this work, we focus on the bias component and study the extent to which SGD can match the optimal convergence behavior of deterministic gradient descent. Assuming only (strong) convexity and smoothness of the objective, we derive new bounds for the full range of constant step-sizes $\gamma L \in (0,2)$. This includes critical and large step-size regimes that were previously unexplored without additional variance assumptions, in both the convex and strongly convex cases. Those bounds are bias-optimal, in the sense that the bias term coincides with the worst-case rate of gradient descent, for all non-critical step-sizes. translated_title: 随机梯度下降的偏差最优界
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）的非渐近分析通常得到的界可分解为偏差项和方差项。在本工作中，我们聚焦于偏差部分，研究SGD在多大程度上能够匹配确定性梯度下降的最优收敛行为。仅在目标函数满足（强）凸性和光滑性的假设下，我们为常数步长的全部范围 $\gamma L \in (0,2)$ 推导出了新的界。这包括了此前在无额外方差假设条件下未曾被探索过的临界步长和较大步长区间，且同时涵盖凸和强凸两种情形。这些界是偏差最优的，即对于所有非临界步长，偏差项与梯度下降的最坏情形速率相一致。对于临界步长，我们证明无法获得具有最优偏差项的界，但该最优偏差可以被任意接近地逼近。
tldr: 本文在仅假设凸性和光滑性的条件下，为随机梯度下降推导出覆盖全部常数步长范围的偏差最优收敛界，并证明在临界步长处最优偏差虽无法精确达到但可被任意逼近。
en_tdlr: This paper derives bias-optimal convergence bounds for SGD over the full range of constant step-sizes under only convexity and smoothness assumptions, showing that at critical step-sizes the optimal bias cannot be attained exactly but can be approximated arbitrarily closely.
